entry.subject: Initial U.S. experimental-validation outreach sent
entry.trigger: The project originator requested that the JANUS Engine technical package be sent to all prioritized U.S. organizations identified in the outreach routing pass.
result: A concise nonconfidential U.S.-style technical brief was created before outreach, emphasizing falsifiable validation rather than a self-powered-engine claim.
Initial emails were sent separately to ONR Global, NUWC Newport TPO, WHOI AOPE, NRL Technology Transfer, DARPA STO solicitation coordination, DIU and ARPA-E.
Each message linked the public JANUS project branch and the frozen R0P1A measurement contract; no confidential attachments or unsupported hardware claims were sent.
The outreach ledger records one initial recipient per organization and the Gmail message IDs so duplicate outreach can be prevented and future replies can be tracked by thread.
The next valid action is reply classification and technical follow-up only when there is new information or an explicit request from the recipient.
entry.decision: Outreach phase is active. Preserve one-recipient-per-organization discipline, do not send duplicate follow-ups automatically, and keep RUN-008 physically blocked until measured P0-P7 data arrive from a capable external partner or laboratory.
